description: Loudness meter to the EBU R128 standard in a narrow panel, reading momentary, short-term and integrated loudness, loudness range, the two dynamics ratios and the maximum true peak

params.text: Clears every integrated, maximum and historical reading and starts the measurement again

inputs.text: The left channel, or the whole signal when it is the only cable; voltages are scaled by a tenth before the measurement, so 10V is taken as full scale
The right channel of a stereo pair
A rise past 1V clears every integrated, maximum and historical reading and starts the measurement again

notes: the same audio measured in stereo reads about 3 LUFS higher than in mono, because the standard sums the energy of both channels, so the processing mode changes the number
the integrated reading is saved with the patch and comes back when it is loaded; everything else starts again from nothing
this is the wide meter's engine in a narrower panel, so the target is set from the menu rather than from a knob
menu: Processing mode: Auto, Mono, Stereo — Auto follows the cables, Mono mixes both inputs down first, Stereo copies a single input to both channels
Short-Term loudness: Disabled, Enabled — switching it off stops the short-term and dynamics readings being worked out at all, which costs less processor time
Target loudness — a slider setting the loudness the momentary bar is measured against, -36 to 0 LUFS; this panel has no knob for it
Add Loudness CV — creates the expander module immediately to the right of this one

inputs.0:
±10V · continuous · one channel only
